review: Opened the actual saved 1536x1024 PNG, not only the generator thumbnail. Independent production reference; no V3 geometry generated.
Front: square planar head and friendly face; cuboid vest/limbs; shoulders join torso, mitten hands join sleeves, boots meet floor; blue trolley badge01 clearly visible.
Side: same stepped headwear/head depth, garment thickness, mitten hand and broad boot sole. A-pose projection explains arms appearing closer to vertical; no disconnected limb observed.
Rear: same headwear, block hair, vest back and wrapped reflective stripe; two connected sleeves/mitten hands and two grounded feet. No pointed nape or extra limb.
Three-quarter: head/torso/limb depth is clear; proportions and stepped headwear match orthographic-style views. Slight perspective is illustrative, not a dimensional drawing.
Bottom five variants preserve base construction and pose. Blue/cart01, orange/carton02, purple/incoming03, green/outgoing04, yellow/forklift05 are visibly distinct without relying on role words.

Compared against actually viewed accepted R01: clean cuboid masses, small bevels, matte flat face language and broad connected silhouette retained. V2 industrial character was not used as artistic target.

No significant reference defect found in this iteration. Metric height, exact shader RGB and working joint/attachment dimensions require later metadata/model/runtime checks; text1.70m is illustrative only.
